headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The day's top news saw several teams secure crucial victories, while others suffered setbacks. The New York Mets continued their dominance with an 11-1 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by Sean Manaea's impressive performance. The Philadelphia Phillies edged the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6, thanks in part to Kyle Schwarber's two home runs and four RBIs.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with key players such as Devin Williams (New York Mets), Caleb Kilian (Philadelphia Phillies), and Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays) landing on the injured list. The New York Mets' Devin Williams has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, while the Philadelphia Phillies' Caleb Kilian is out with a left oblique strain.

The Kansas City Royals made a significant move, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with the Nationals dominating the game from start to finish. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with a 3-hit performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Caleb Kilian earning the win. Kyle Schwarber led the Phillies' offense with two home runs and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets RHP Devin Williams Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Mets right-handed pitcher Devin Williams has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. The move is retroactive to August 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's first base position.
